description: DNP3 message bodies and envelopes as a passive network monitor publishes them, recorded by passing each fragment through Wireshark's DNP3 dissector and the monitor's parser. Each fragment was sent as its own TCP segment between the two endpoints below. Each envelope is shown without its version field, which names the producer's own release.
